notes:
### 📡 Finds your phone faster
- Tether now also finds your phone through Bonjour, which works on office and campus Wi-Fi that blocks KDE Connect's usual broadcasts. When your phone drops off Wi-Fi and comes back, it reconnects on its own within seconds instead of waiting up to 45. By @zzjjaayy (#7)
- On Macs with corporate security software, discovery could freeze at launch, so a phone that dropped off Wi-Fi was never found again until Tether restarted. Fixed by @zzjjaayy (#6)
- macOS may ask once whether Tether can find devices on your local network. Allow it so Bonjour discovery works.

### 📁 Phone drive
- Fixed "server not responding" prompts asking you to disconnect when your phone went out of range or to sleep while its drive was open.

### 🔒 Pairing
- Accepting a pairing request now only ever pairs the device you were shown, even if another request arrives while the prompt is open. By @youp211 (#9)

Thank you @zzjjaayy and @youp211!
